_comment: F2 golden — lib/provisional-figures.ts ADMISSION_PRODUCTS + WORKSHOP_FIELD_TRIP_PRODUCTS after Brad's message 6 (2026-10-07, verbatim in .agent/memory/scratch/brad-ticket-news-2026-10-07.md). SUPERSEDES this golden's own prior revision from earlier the same day (vip/weekend-pass/day-visitor/early-bird reconciled against Lee-Ann's sheet only) — message 6 changes the EARLY-BIRD MECHANISM for weekend-pass and day-visitor from date-cutoff to a shared sold-count pool, and excludes Thursday from Day Pass days. Conferences/Workshops (F1) are handled separately and are NOT touched here.

newSharedPoolConstant._note: Brad message 6: '500 early bird day v[i]stor tickets, 3 day booking and 1 day book[ing] all count to 500' and 'Earlybird now ends after 500 tickets are sold not at a specific date'. One shared pool, not a per-product tranche — see architectureChange below for why this needs a genuinely new product (weekend-pass-early-bird), not just a value edit.

architectureChange_weekendPassSplit.why: Before message 6, 'weekend-pass' was a SINGLE product/SKU with two prices (price=early-bird, regularPrice=regular) switched by a date (earlyBirdCutoff). Message 6 makes weekend-pass's early-bird tier share ONE pool with day-visitor's early-bird tier, counted by units sold, with NO date at all. A single SKU's own two-price-by-date mechanism cannot express 'shared with a DIFFERENT product's sold count' — the project's EXISTING capacityPool/headcountPerUnit mechanism (already live for the Sunset Cocktails single/couple shared pool, enforced race-safely by lib/checkout-reservation.ts#planPooledCapacity, F3-golden-reused, not reinvented) can, but only across distinct SKUs. So weekend-pass SPLITS into two products, mirroring the shape day-visitor's early-bird already has (a separate slug, not a second price on one slug): 'weekend-pass' (regular only) and a NEW 'weekend-pass-early-bird' slug.
architectureChange_weekendPassSplit.newDocumentIsGenuinelyNew: weekend-pass-early-bird is a NEW product, not a renamed/retired/recreated one. Its live Sanity document does NOT need special-case migration code: scripts/seed-ticketing.ts already iterates ADMISSION_PRODUCTS generically and calls client.createIfNotExists() per product (scripts/seed-ticketing.ts:181) — once this feature adds the product to the array, re-running the EXISTING, unmodified seed script creates its document automatically. F3's migration script therefore keeps its patch-never-create rule with NO exception; it only patches documents that already exist.

Post-split, does 300 still cap the REGULAR weekend-pass alone, independent of the 500-pool early-bird sales — or should the two be read together some other way? updatedInPlace.name: Weekend Pass (Early Bird)
updatedInPlace._capacityNote: Declares the FULL shared-pool ceiling (500), per this codebase's existing capacityPool convention (every pool sibling declares the full pool ceiling as its own capacity field — see sunset-cocktails-single/couple precedent) — not a sub-allocation of 500 for this slug alone.
updatedInPlace._note: Brad message 6, sheet line 22 price carried over (360). Shares the 'admission-early-bird' pool with the day-visitor early-bird slug below — every sale of EITHER counts toward the same 500. Once the pool is exhausted, this product becomes unavailable via the EXISTING pool-capacity-exhausted path (same behavior Sunset Cocktails already has on sellout) — buyers fall through to the independent 'weekend-pass' regular product, which is a separate SKU and is not blocked by this one's sellout.

updatedInPlace.name: Day Visitor Ticket
updatedInPlace._excludedDaysNote: NEW field. Brad message 6: 'No Daypass on thursday it VIP meet ht e botoniosts and seperate cocktails tickets afterwards' + 'Day Pass days are Fri 24 to Sun 26 only'. 2027-09-23 is the confirmed Thursday of the 23-26 Sept 2027 show window (see project memory project_show_dates_placeholder.md). capacity=1000 is SUPERSEDED as a single-aggregate reading by team-lead's third-pass correction (2026-10-07): this pre-existing, long-flagged gap (docs/f4-admission-products.md 'Known scope gap') IS fixed by this mission's F4, via a day-qualified pool key (`${poolKeyBase}::${chosenDay}`) fed into the UNCHANGED planPooledCapacity() — true independent 1000-caps for Friday/Saturday/Sunday, proven by a mandatory concurrency assertion (F4 A11/A18). This field's own value (1000) is unchanged; what changed is that it is now enforced per-day, not as one aggregate pool.

updatedInPlace.name: Day Visitor (Early Bird)
updatedInPlace._nameChangeNote: Same slug/_id preserved (continuity for any already-issued order) — this slug is the Day Visitor's own early-bird tier.
updatedInPlace._capacityNote: Declares the FULL shared-pool ceiling (500) — same convention as weekend-pass-early-bird above; this is the SAME pool, not a second independent 500.
updatedInPlace._earlyBirdCutoffChangeNote: Cleared to null (was the legacy 2027-07-31 constant, carried over in the earlier-same-day revision). Message 6: 'Earlybird now ends after 500 tickets are sold not at a specific date' — supersedes the date-cutoff entirely for this slug.
updatedInPlace._excludedDaysNote: Same Thursday exclusion as its sibling day-visitor product — this is still a day-visitor-shaped ticket, just at the early-bird price.
updatedInPlace._note: Shares the 'admission-early-bird' pool with weekend-pass-early-bird — combined sold+reserved count across BOTH slugs is checked against the single 500 ceiling by the existing planPooledCapacity() mechanism (see F3). Once exhausted, falls through to the independent 'day-visitor' regular product at R150.

sunsetCocktailsReconciliation._poolCapacityNote: Unchanged by message 6. This mission (message 6) does not touch that number either way — 'unchanged' means unchanged at its CURRENT real value, 200, not a reversion to the superseded 100.

sunset-cocktails-couple._priceNote: UNCHANGED figure. Team-lead's second-pass default (2026-10-07): set active:false via a NEW RETIRED_SUNSET_COCKTAILS_SLUGS export (see below), patched by F3's migration — NOT deleted, same convention as RETIRED_CONFERENCE_SLUGS/RETIRED_FIELD_TRIP_SLUGS. sunsetCocktailsReconciliation._stillOpenTimeOverlap: VIP (Thu 16h00-19h00) and Sunset Cocktails (Thu 18h00-21h00) overlap 18h00-19h00 on the same day — NOT addressed by message 6, still an open needs-Brad item, not assumed to be intentional or a conflict.

newRetirementExport._note: New export, same shape/convention as RETIRED_CONFERENCE_SLUGS and RETIRED_FIELD_TRIP_SLUGS — a list of slugs F3's migration sets active:false on, never deletes. Kept in this figures file (not the migration script) so the retirement list has one source of truth alongside the product it names.

fieldTripUnchanged._note: Not on Lee-Ann's sheet or in any of Brad's six messages. Flagged, NOT deleted or altered.

schemaImpact: Two new OPTIONAL fields on ProvisionalAdmissionProduct: `excludedDays?: string[] | null` (ISO date strings this product does not sell for, additive, defaults to no exclusion when absent — zero behavior change for every other existing product) and the already-existing `capacityPool`/`headcountPerUnit` pair, reused rather than re-invented, now also applied to weekend-pass-early-bird and the early-bird slug. No Sanity schema field is needed for capacityPool/headcountPerUnit (already exist, used by sunset-cocktails) — see F3. excludedDays DOES need one new, additive Sanity field — see F3.
_newOpenQuestion_weekendPassDayCap: Added by team-lead (2026-10-07, second pass): does a Weekend Pass holder count against the Day Visitor's 1000-per-day cap on each of the three days they attend? NOT assumed either way. F4's true per-day capacity mechanism is designed to make weekend-pass's participation in the day cap an additive, easy-to-enable-later choice rather than requiring it be decided now — the DEFAULT this feature ships with is that weekend-pass does NOT draw against the day-visitor per-day pool (they are separate ticket types with separate historical capacity figures: 300 for the weekend pass overall vs. 1000/day for day visitors) — flagged, not a resolution.
